## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `64621932a041ae40dc91da0c1c63b1bab9d0cc86`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs (MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB_ROWS, the `docs/adr/**` row and the clause-① docblock), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS row 188, MAX_LINE_BYTES 120), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (scan root, ID_PATTERN), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md line 311 (claim template `Container & model:`), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md lines 137-138, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md lines 79-86 (human floor), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md line 31, .github/workflows/lint.yml (job `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, steps `PM skill line ratchet` and `PM skill issue-ID lint`)

Inputs read: card #29741 body and all three comments (triage audit 6595070364, claim 6597637142, os-dev-report 6597914303); PR #29850 body, file list (one file, +2/-2) and `git diff origin/main...pr/29850` (origin/main c5ddbea9 is contained in the head; two commits, 3c7c757f and the merge 64621932); the check-runs on 64621932. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not inputs.

Check-runs on the head (conclusions are the gate verdicts): all 23 non-skipped runs `success` at completion — Auto Label, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates (carries `PM skill line ratchet` and `PM skill issue-ID lint`), the three Lint · scoped runs, PR-body guards, Test Core, Test UI, Type Check · consumer gates / debt ledger / source gates / workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter. The remaining runs are `skipped` (paths-filtered: Build Core, Build Docs, UI builds and shards, dogfood shards, opt-in harnesses).

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: no change. The diff is two rewritten prose lines in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`; no schema, no ledger, no refusal path, no runtime code moves. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and in the claim comment, no arm — right.
- Public surface: no change. `.claude/**` ships in no released package (check-skill-id-lint's header: internal corpus, not the published `skills/` catalog); nothing a consumer imports or an author writes moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` — right.
- Governed surface: `.claude/**` is on the Prime Directive #14 register (Tier S, owning seat on a contract-tier review of record). `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success` on the head; this record is that review. The served tier reads off the rules face (`--paths` prints CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for this hits file) — right.
- Line ratchet: the tree holds the file at 188 lines against its CEILINGS row of 188 (net zero, as the card required), and lines 101 and 122 each measure exactly 120 bytes against MAX_LINE_BYTES 120; no other line was re-wrapped (the diff is exactly two hunks of one line each). Read from the tree, confirmed by `PM skill line ratchet` inside `Lint · repo & tooling gates` = `success` — right.
- Issue-ID lint: neither rewritten line carries a `#NNN` citation, a ruling date or a quotation; provenance (Warren, 2026-11-03T03:05Z, option A) stays in the PR body, which is what check-skill-id-lint's header prescribes. `PM skill issue-ID lint` in the same job = `success` — right.
- dispatch-gates.data.mjs: the `docs/adr/**` MANDATORY row still reads 「the same order fixes the effort floor at xhigh (the PM skill states it beside clause ①)」. On the head, clause ① no longer states a floor for every `docs/adr/**` card; the floor now lives one section lower on line 122 (`ADR` in the `xhigh` list). The data row's pointer is one line off but names the same file and the same policy; the table is documented as a copy of ONE predicate (tier) and 「when they disagree, the skill wins」, so nothing mechanical reads the effort floor. Judged right to leave untouched in a net-zero rules PR; noted under ④ as a should-fix pointer refresh for the next PR that touches that row.
- Mirror obligation (card's last bullet): measured on the head. SKILL.md line 311 already names 「常设档位令的 id 与时刻」 as a `reason:` form; dispatch-runbook.md line 137 says 「档位与 effort 席位自推导 ⛔ 不等维护者原话」 and line 138 「常设原话有则作 `reason:`」; coordinator.md line 31 points at execution-duties for both. No surface repeats a per-card maintainer ask, so no mirror edit was owed — the dev's reading holds against the tree.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` label on the PR; `Check Changeset` = `success`. The diff publishes nothing from any released package (one file under `.claude/`), so the label is the correct declaration and a `patch` changeset would be wrong. `Clause-②: no` line-initial on the PR body, no `(widening)`/`(narrowing)` arm; `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial. No changeset body exists to carry a second copy, and none is owed. Level: none (skip-changeset) — matches the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

os-dev-report 6597914303 lists three deviations and no `open_questions`; each answered against the tree:

1. Attribution line carries the card thread's link instead of the skills-lane thread link — a PR-body provenance detail, same project and requester; nothing in the tree depends on it. Accepted, no action.
2. No PR subscription and no assignee/reviewer request from the dev thread — that is the rule, not a deviation: dispatch-runbook.md line 140 「线程 ⛔ 不做 harness 开 PR 后指派/请审 … 请审是席位交棒」. Accepted.
3. Line 122 wording moved beyond the card's ask to fit 120 bytes: `security` lost its backticks (its neighbour `p1` was already bare; no gate pins line 122's text — the only script carrying `xhigh` outside comments is the dispatch-gates data row, which does not read this file), 「凭点名或常设令」 became 「凭点名/常设令」 (same separator the list already uses, same meaning), and 条款① dropped 凡/一律 for 即 (same reach: every card touching the two surfaces is CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER; 强制 kept as the anchor other lines cite). Accepted; the one wording question that matters is raised under ④.

No boundary needs escalation to the maintainer: the standing order is the maintainer's own word (option A 「fable + xhigh,立为常设令」 then 「这个应该立卡更新 skills」), and the PR records it without widening tier, effort or the one-line-exit policy.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged file: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (lines 101 and 122), against the rules it cites and the scenario the card accepts it against — docs-only ADR cards dispatch at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER + effort `xhigh` fixed with no per-card ask; `max` stays named; cards outside the order (a new decision, a superseding ADR, an ADR+code mixed diff) keep their existing routes.

Does the rewritten 条款① still carry everything the old line said?

- Tier half. Old 「凡改协议语义面或 `docs/adr/**` 的卡一律契约复审档」, new 「改协议语义面或 `docs/adr/**` 即契约复审档」: same two surfaces, same mandate, and the machine copy (MANDATORY_TIER_GLOB_ROWS: SKILL.md, os-dev.md, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`, all CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER) still matches it. Lines 102-106 (协议语义面 definition, references-only downgrade, no one-line exit under `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**`) are untouched and still bind. Holds.
- Effort floor for every `docs/adr/**` card (the old 「后者 effort 下限 `xhigh`」). It is gone from line 101 and re-stated on line 122 as `ADR` in the `xhigh` list, with the tail `max` 凭点名/常设令 unchanged. Line 122 is the effort assignment table (line 121: effort 按卡难度定 … 写进 Container & model 行与派发令); an ADR card therefore reads `xhigh`, and the only effort above it, `max`, needs a named word or a standing order — which is exactly 「下限 xhigh」 expressed as an assignment. A mixed ADR+code card or a superseding ADR is still an 「ADR 类」 card (the file's own vocabulary, line 130 「ADR 类 draft-only」) touching `docs/adr/**`, so it keeps `xhigh`. Holds; no downgrade path opened.
- `max` on an ADR card. The old tail already read 凭点名或常设令; the new tail reads 凭点名/常设令 — unchanged in meaning. The 2026-11-03 standing order names `xhigh`, not `max`, so `max` on an ADR card remains a per-card named word. Holds.

Is the standing order bounded as the card asks?

- 「纯文档 ADR 常设令 `xhigh`,免逐卡问」. 纯文档 (no code, no spec) excludes the ADR+code mixed diff by its own words. It does NOT, by its own words, exclude a superseding ADR or an ADR card that needs a new decision — both are docs-only `docs/adr/**` diffs by path. Those two exclusions survive only through rules elsewhere: `needs-user-decision` cards are never dispatch candidates (execution-duties.md line 8, SKILL.md line 107), and triage-duties.md lines 79 and 86 put 「ADR」, 「契约/ADR 变化」 and 「⑥悖于既裁或立新常设令」 on the human floor, so a superseding ADR reaches the maintainer as a decision before any dispatch. The tier and effort a seat would then apply are the same (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, `xhigh`), so no card lands at a lower tier or effort than the card's scenario demands. The PR body concedes the wording choice (「there was no byte room to list the three exclusions inline」). Should-fix: the scoping word carries only one of the three exclusions on its face; the reader must know the human floor to recover the other two. A tighter word (e.g. 修订 / 增补 for an amendment-class edit) or a pointer to the human floor would close it; byte room exists only by trading the 强制 anchor or re-wrapping, which is why this is not a must-fix.
- 「免逐卡问」 removes the per-card ask for tier AND effort on docs-only ADR cards, which is what the maintainer ordered; it does not remove the human-floor presentation of the ADR content itself (triage-duties line 79 「人工地板(恒呈维护者):…ADR…」), which is a different ask and still stands. Holds.

Does line 122's change widen anything it should not?

- Adding `ADR` to the `xhigh` list widens effort only upward and only for the class the old 条款① already floored at `xhigh`; `security` and `p1` are already in that list, so an ADR card that is also p1 or security reads the same. A code card implementing an ADR is not 「ADR 类」 in this file's usage (line 130 ties the class to draft-only landing, i.e. the `docs/adr/**` Tier H surface), so the bare word does not pull implementation cards up to `xhigh`. No improper widening. The dropped backticks on `security` and the 或→/ substitution change no meaning (see ③.3).
- Pointer drift, should-fix, outside this PR's single file: the `docs/adr/**` row in scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs still says the effort floor is stated 「beside clause ①」; on the head it is stated on line 122. Nothing reads that prose mechanically and the card bounded this PR to a net-zero edit of one file, so it is a refresh for the next PR that touches that row, not a reason to hold this one.

Tried to break it, no must-fix found: no card class loses its CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER mandate; no `docs/adr/**` card can be dispatched below `xhigh`; `max` still needs a named word; the one-line exit is still closed under `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` (line 104 and the data rows' `oneLineExit: false`); the file stays at its ceiling with both rewritten lines at the byte cap; the two gates that judge the file are green on the head.

Findings:
- should-fix — line 101's scoping word 纯文档 ADR excludes the mixed diff on its face but leaves a superseding ADR and a new-decision ADR card inside the standing order by wording; they stay out only via the human floor (triage-duties.md 79/86) and the never-dispatched `needs-user-decision` state, which the line does not point at.
- should-fix — scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs `docs/adr/**` row's 「the PM skill states it beside clause ①」 now points one section too high; refresh with the next PR that touches that row.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-n4zt18`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- Residual reading, no finding: 修订 describes the ADR edit, not the whole diff, so an ADR+code mixed card that revises an ADR is not excluded on the face of line 101 the way 纯文档 excluded it. domain:skills#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：派发规则写明，ADR 修订卡（修订说明、措辞修正、`Amended by` 条目）按常设令固定走契约复审档、effort `xhigh`，不再逐卡问维护者；需要新裁决的卡（含替代 ADR）除外。effort 表把 ADR 列进 `xhigh`，`max` 仍需点名。
- 为什么改：你 2026-11-03 已把 ADR 卡的档位与 effort 定为常设令，但规则原文只写了下限，席位每张 ADR 卡还在开决裁线程问一遍。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `execution-duties.md` 两行规则文字，行数不变，不动代码和发布面。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`execution-duties.md` 第 101 行（条款①）与第 122 行（effort 表）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` 均绿，文件仍 188 行。
- 需要你做的：无。Tier S，席位按复审 PASS 落地。

席位意见：常设令已记入规则，新裁决的边界也写在同一行，同意落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#3 · head `bd51c884900f31f642c067182c3afa39be7d4e85`
